FAQ

Frequently asked questions

Are ambulance services available 24/7?

We provide 24/7 ambulance support. Call +91 80968 58661 to confirm availability.

Do you provide ICU and oxygen ambulances?

ICU and oxygen ambulance services are available subject to vehicle and requirement availability.

Can you arrange outstation ambulance transport?

Yes, outstation patient transportation can be arranged subject to route and vehicle availability.

Do you provide Dead Body Freezer Box Service?

Yes. Freezer box rental/support is available subject to availability. Please call for details.

How do I book an ambulance?

Call +91 80968 58661 or use WhatsApp. Share pickup location, destination and patient requirement.
